audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's cooldown, dosFull and report[5] rows all track Last Breath and never once mention Wind Wall — the single most important interaction in this matchup — while the content layer's prose covers it properly. The two layers disagreed about what the reader should watch.
audit.why: Every damage source Kayle has is a projectile: her passive fire waves, Q (Radiant Blast) and E (Starfire Spellblade) are all flagged projectile in the kit. Wind Wall blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds on a 25/23/21/19/17s cooldown, so it deletes her entire ranged output, not just her Q. Last Breath is 70/50/30s and cannot be cast without a knockup first, so denying the Steel Tempest tornado (4s cooldown, tornado on the second stack) also denies the ult.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall's 25s cooldown and 4s duration, Steel Tempest's 4s/second-stack tornado, and Last Breath's knockup prerequisite now all appear in the full layer.
